title: Slo Mocean Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Slo Mocean is a 5.00 bedroom, 5.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: 12 EAST RUSKIN STREET*Please be advised that neighboring properties may currently be undergoing construction or renovation during your stay. As a result, intermittent noise or construction-related activity may occur at certain times throughout the day. This work is managed by third parties outside of our control, and we appreciate your understanding while enjoying the property. For additional questions or concerns regarding nearby construction activity, please contact Homeowner’s Collection at 1-855-411-1557.A Thoughtfully Designed Coastal Retreat in Seaside, FloridaSlo Mocean is one of Seaside’s newer luxury homes, offering a refined coastal aesthetic and a layout designed for gathering, relaxation, and effortless beach living. Ideally located along Scenic Highway 30A near East Ruskin Street, this exceptional property blends timeless Seaside architecture with modern comfort and thoughtful details throughout. From the moment you arrive, Slo Mocean feels welcoming, elevated, and unmistakably special.Inviting Outdoor Living & Seamless Indoor FlowA welcoming front porch faces iconic Highway 30A, offering a peaceful place to relax and watch the rhythm of Seaside life pass by. Just off the porch, a private outdoor shower leads directly into a convenient mudroom outfitted with a stand-alone ice maker and full-size washer and dryer—perfect after a day at the beach. A second side porch overlooks charming East Ruskin Street, creating another cozy space for morning coffee or evening breezes.Inside, the first-floor living area is warm and inviting, featuring beautiful hardwood floors, coastal-inspired furnishings, and an open layout that encourages conversation and connection.First-Floor King Suites with Private BathsThe main level hosts three beautifully appointed king bedrooms, each with its own private en-suite bathroom. Every room is thoughtfully styled with locally inspired artwork, vibrant accent pillows, and carefully curated furnishings that reflect the relaxed elegance of Seaside and 30A. Natural light fills the space, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere ideal for rest and retreat.Second-Floor Living, Dining & Chef’s KitchenAscend the stunning wood staircase to the second floor, where a half bath is conveniently located on the landing. Upstairs, an additional living area opens to outdoor living space and features comfortable seating and a television—perfect for casual lounging or evening gatherings. The adjacent outdoor area includes a mounted flat-screen TV, creating an inviting setting for open-air entertainment under the stars.The heart of the home is the expansive dining and kitchen space. A large dining table seats up to 12 guests, ideal for shared meals and celebrations. The chef’s kitchen is exceptionally well appointed with high-end appliances, generous counter space, bar seating for three, and a charming Romeo-and-Juliet balcony just off the kitchen that adds both light and character.Also on this level is an additional king bedroom and a spacious bunk room featuring four built-in twin beds and a trundle, making it a perfect setup for kids or extended family.Third-Floor Loft & Iconic Seaside Tower ViewsThe third floor offers a cozy loft-style retreat with a television—ideal for quiet downtime, reading, or movie nights. From here, continue up to the tower, where sweeping views of the Gulf of Mexico and the rooftops of Seaside unfold. This elevated perch is the perfect place to watch sunsets, take in the coastal breeze, and truly appreciate the beauty of this iconic beach town.Optional Detached Guest Cottage: SeasuiteSlo Mocean also offers the option to rent the detached guest cottage, Seasuite, located just off the stone pathway from the main home. This private cottage features a queen bedroom and full bath on the first floor, with an upstairs sitting area and kitchenette showcasing stunning glass tile inlaid countertops. A washer and dryer are included within the unit, making Seasuite an ideal addition for couples, guests, or extended family seeking a bit more privacy.Slo Mocean delivers the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and prime location—offering multiple living spaces, exceptional outdoor areas, and unforgettable views, all just steps from the beach and the heart of Seaside.* 7-night Saturday to Saturday minimum Summer, 5-night minimum Spring & Spring Break; 3-night minimum for Fall; 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. FEATURES3,593 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space1-minute walk (59 feet) to beach accessPrivate Seaside residential beach at East Ruskin Pavilion, the largest private residential beach on 30AFour king bedrooms, ideal for families and groupsDigital streaming TVs in all bedrooms (no cable)Outdoor television for open-air entertainmentFreestanding ice maker for easy beach days and gatheringsWasher and dryer are conveniently located in the homePeacock Alley Linens – fresh, luxurious towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes issued. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002087
